text:
Eva: Morning — we have a release-train slot tomorrow at 09:00 PST (us-west2). 30m window. Canary plan 5% -> 50%. Need owners for runtime/model-serving, console, and infra (DB migration). Who can own runtime?
Kyle: I can take runtime. Will run canary 09:00-09:10 and do smoke checks.
Marta: I’ll take console but PR #3421 needs to be merged before the slot. Pinged @Samir for review.
Samir: On it, will review in ~15m.
Cheng: The DB migration will require a ~2m exclusive lock at ~09:12. It's a small schema change + backfill. Is that ok?
Eva: OK — make sure migration script has a --dry-run and we have backups. Add the migration step to the release runbook.
deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy window reserved: release-train/slot-1712345678 locked by @Eva :lock: (CI gate still required)
Remy: I can be rollback owner. If we abort, I’ll run rollback and coordinate customer comms.
Kyle: Smoke plan for runtime: health check + sample inference load. I’ll run the following before and during canary:
```bash
# quick health check
curl -sfS https://runtime.us-west2.redwood.ai/health || echo "health:FAIL"
# sample inference load (local tool)
ab -n 20 -c 2 -p sample_payload.json https://runtime.us-west2.redwood.ai/v1/generate
```
Kyle: Abort criteria: error rate >5% OR p95 latency >2000ms. If hit, abort & hand to rollback owner.
Marta: Console smoke: login -> create org -> run sample create + list flows. Can someone provision a test org (release-train-42)?
Samir: Provisioned test org `release-train-42`, creds posted to internal vault.
Cheng: I’ll coordinate the DB lock and post migration checksum before running. Plan is to run migration at 09:12 right after the first canary bump.
Marta: Merging PR #3421 now — will tag build once merged.
Samir: Reviewed and approved. @Marta go for merge.
deploy-bot: CI passed for build 9921 :white_check_mark: (artifact: rdt-runtime:9921)
Kyle: I’ll be online 08:45 to warm caches and watch metrics (errors, qps, p95).
Eva: Notes: abort thresholds = 5% errors or >2s p95. Rollback script path: /ops/release/rollback/run.sh — Remy to run if abort. Runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/release-train (add migration and smoke steps there).
Remy: Copy — I’ll familiarize myself with rollback script and will be oncall 08:45-10:00.
Marta: Build tagged and deployment job is queued. If anything blocks, I’ll post here; otherwise see you all tomorrow at 08:50 final preflight.
Eva: Thanks all — please react with :white_check_mark: if you’ll be present for the slot. I’ll do a final rollcall 08:50.
Kyle: :white_check_mark:
Marta: :white_check_mark:
Samir: :white_check_mark:
Cheng: :white_check_mark:
Remy: :white_check_mark:
